{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, check if there are any non-numeric values after removing commas
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Found {len(qa_orders)} QA orders with revenue 999999.99')

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Verify the clean dataset
print(f'Clean dataset shape: {df_clean.shape}')"}
